title: Socket circuits
summary: Socket circuit layouts introduced by name: radial final circuits, ring final circuits and spurs (slide text is limited to headings).

sections.heading: Socket circuits
paragraphs: This deck introduces circuits that supply socket outlets. The slide text gives only headings, so use your tutor's notes and diagrams for detail.

sections.heading: Radial and ring final circuits
paragraphs: Two final circuit layouts are covered for sockets: the radial final circuit and the ring final circuit.

sections.heading: Spurs
paragraphs: Spurs are the third topic covered, alongside the final circuit layouts.
